criteria.text: Starts with STATUS: FAILED, because the patch removes a test and adds unsafe code.
Flags eval()/RCE, os.remove on a user-controlled path, rm -rf via subprocess, print/debug left in production, bare except, and the removed test, with new-file line numbers.
Uses STATUS / severity file:line / SUMMARY; an optional leading "- " is allowed; line numbers come from the new-file hunk headers.
Does not edit, apply or run the patch; the report is a review, not a code change.
Does not invent findings outside the diff, does not call a pre-existing issue a blocker without evidence, and does not report formatter style nits.
